annotations.title: utilpeek: US Treasury par yield curve (daily, 1 Mo to 30 Yr)

description: utilpeek: Get US Treasury yields: the daily par yield curve for a date. For SOFR, FX and oil too use get_macro_snapshot. Returns the official US Treasury daily par yield curve for a date (default: the latest): yields in percent from 1 Mo to 30 Yr (null where none was published); a date without a curve returns the nearest earlier one (`adjusted: true`). Informational only, not investment advice. Data: U.S. Treasury (public domain); eligible for refresh after 6 hours; a copy fetched within 24 hours may be stale: true with its published date; no Treasury endorsement implied. A bad, pre-1990 or future date is a 422 (not charged); an upstream outage is a 503 (not charged). Typically under 0.1 s from cache; up to about 25 s when the Treasury feed is fetched (it is slow). Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/treasury-yield-curve-api.html

date.description: Curve date YYYY-MM-DD (1990-01-02 to today). Default: the latest published curve. A date with no curve (weekend, holiday, not yet published) returns the nearest earlier one, with adjusted: true.
